summary: Offerpad Solutions Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register the sale of up to $69,738,969 of its Class A common stock through an at-the-market offering via Jefferies LLC as agent. The shares are sold under a Sales Agreement dated August 28, 2025, with no fixed number of shares or price. The filing is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. At-the-market offerings are ordinary capital-raising activities. No premium, terms, or catalysts for a special-situation classification exist.
